meta.title: Kenya consumer price index
meta.source: World Bank, World Development Indicators, FP.CPI.TOTL (Consumer price index, 2010 = 100), Kenya
meta.method: Fiscal-year index is the simple average of the two calendar-year indices that the fiscal year spans (for example FY2015/16 = average of 2015 and 2016). This is an approximation: it ignores the timing of spending within the year.
